title: Gradle plugin applied without a version
description: build.gradle declares a plugin request that names no version. The plugin resolves to its latest release, and a build plugin runs arbitrary code during configuration, so the change is both invisible and code-executing.
remediation: Pin the plugin version, preferably through the settings plugin block or a version catalog.
limitation: It matches a plugin request that names no version in the parsed build.gradle; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
